@graph.name: PhilaPort Logistics Dataset
@graph.description: The per-port dataset for PhilaPort — the Port of Philadelphia — in the Ports & Intermodal program of The Flat Rate Movers: the full port record for the landlord port of the Philadelphia Regional Port Authority (PhilaPort, Commonwealth of Pennsylvania), run by private terminal operators under lease — Packer Avenue Marine Terminal (Greenwich Terminals LLC; 160 acres, 6 berths plus 1 RoRo berth, 45 ft depth, on-dock refrigeration), Tioga Marine Terminal (Delaware River Stevedores; 116 acres) and the Southport Auto Terminal (Glovis America; opened October 2019) — the port's container volume on PhilaPort's named bases (889,268 TEU in CY2025, a port record, up 6 percent and up 39 percent since 2020; 64 percent of containerized imports refrigerated in CY2025; ranked #1 in North America for productivity in the World Bank/S&P Container Port Performance Index, 2024 index), CSX and Norfolk Southern service at every PhilaPort terminal via Conrail Shared Assets switching, the I-95, I-76, I-70 and I-81 corridors, and the branch binding: the port is bound to the Martinsburg, WV branch on drive time (about 3:23), the road distances being effectively tied at about 191 miles from Martinsburg and 193 from Winchester — no mileage advantage is claimed. No port-wide total tonnage is published. The company's eight attached port services are recorded cell by cell in the companion coverage dataset. No port tenancy or port-authority relationship is claimed; the company's crews hold TWIC cards and its contractors hold valid TWIC cards.

@graph.name: PhilaPort Service Coverage Dataset
@graph.description: The service-coverage cells for the PhilaPort in the Ports & Intermodal program: the eight attached services (transloading; ocean container packing and unpacking; loading and unloading / container labor; cross-docking; freight rework; specialized workforce; logistics project management; 3PL support services), each recorded as offered with its delivery points (port-adjacent warehouse, receiver's dock, yard, leased space, and on-terminal by arrangement — on-terminal work happens only by arrangement through the terminal's own processes, never as a bare claim) and its bound branch, Martinsburg, WV. Drayage is not offered at any port in the program.

@graph.name: PhilaPort — Port of Philadelphia
@graph.description: PhilaPort — Port of Philadelphia (Philadelphia, PA) — deepwater marine port (containers, reefer, breakbulk, forest products, autos). Authority: PhilaPort (Philadelphia Regional Port Authority, Commonwealth of Pennsylvania). Operator: Private terminal operators under lease (landlord port): Packer Avenue — Greenwich Terminals LLC; Tioga — Delaware River Stevedores; Southport Auto — Glovis America. Cargo: refrigerated and perishable cargo — 64 percent of containerized imports were refrigerated (CY2025); containers; forest products (newsprint, coated paper, wood pulp); breakbulk and project cargo; cocoa (Pier 84); autos. Rail: CSX — at every PhilaPort terminal, via Conrail Shared Assets switching; Norfolk Southern — at every PhilaPort terminal, via Conrail Shared Assets switching. Highway corridors: I-95, I-76, I-70, I-81. Volume (CY2025, calendar): 889,268 TEU — PhilaPort containers — a port record (+6 percent; +39 percent since 2020) (source: The Produce News / PhilaPort, CY2025 results, via ports program dossier §1.5). Branch binding: this port is served from the Martinsburg, WV branch of The Flat Rate Movers — about 193 road miles from Winchester and 191 from Martinsburg; bound to Martinsburg on time. bound on drive time only — road miles are tied (difference 0-3 mi); no mileage advantage is claimed.
